run_loader_minirts: run the Loader class to initialize minirts game environment with actor and train specs
create_actor_spec: create an actor specification with input keys s, base_hp_level, last_r, and terminal
create_train_spec: create a training specification with input keys rv, pi, s, base_hp_level, a, last_r, V, terminal
register_actor_callback: register an actor callback function that returns zero actions for the game environment
run_gc_loop: run the game controller loop for n iterations and compute FPS timing statistics
